scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @icewater/server" "npm run dev -w @icewater/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @icewater/shared && npm run build -w @icewater/server && npm run build -w @icewater/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @icewater/shared && npm run typecheck -w @icewater/server && npm run typecheck -w @icewater/web
